svg.desc: Wiring diagram for the LibreRoaster coffee roaster firmware on ESP32-C3. All pins verified against src/config/constants.rs, src/hardware/init.rs, docs/HARDWARE.md and docs/pinout.md.
svg.text: All pins verified against firmware source · docs/HARDWARE.md · docs/pinout.md · ESP32-C3 (RISC-V)
input · internal pull-up · LOW = SSR ON
⚠ straps: GPIO2 · GPIO8 · GPIO9 — see notes
shared SPI bus · 1 MHz · mode 1 (CPOL=0, CPHA=1)
TYPE-K TC — ET probe · yellow (+), red (−)
TYPE-K TC — BT probe · yellow (+), red (−)
SSR switches mains L · disconnect before wiring
FAN STAGE — GPIO9 · 25 kHz PWM ⚠ STRAP
strap pin: 10 kΩ pull-up keeps boot HIGH
series 1 kΩ + gate pull-down 100 kΩ weak (fan OFF at boot)
⚠ 5 V CH341 clones damage GPIO20/21 — 3.3 V only
Never exceed 3.6 V on any GPIO
Back-powering: 10 kΩ series on external signals
